note: Legal movie and TV services that work in Ethiopia. Prices and availability change, so check each service before paying. To suggest a change, edit this file and open a pull request.

services.name: teleStream (Ethio telecom)
services.description: Ethio telecom's internet TV: 60+ live channels and about 350 on-demand titles. Sold with internet packages through the telebirr SuperApp or a service center.

services.name: TeleTV
services.description: Online cinema by Ethio telecom and EagleLion. Rent Amharic films and pay with telebirr (Visa/Mastercard from abroad).

services.name: MayaFlicks
services.description: Ethiopian films, series and documentaries by actress-producer Ameleset Muchie. Pay with telebirr or airtime. Web, Android and iPhone.

services.name: Sodere
services.description: Ethiopian movies and premieres by monthly or yearly subscription, with new films added regularly.

services.name: Netflix
services.description: Works in Ethiopia, but it needs an international Visa/Mastercard, which many Ethiopian bank cards can't do.

services.name: Free classic films (Internet Archive)
services.description: Thousands of old films that are in the public domain and free to watch. Already built into this app on the Free films tab.
